title: Songbook collection, version 1
description: A collection.json: a named list of songbooks, hosted at any URL. Book URLs resolve against the collection document's own URL, so a folder holding collection.json and its .sbk files is a complete collection. Extensions go in properties prefixed with "x-", which readers ignore.

$schema.description: URI of this schema, so editors can validate the file.

collection.description: Format version. An incompatible future format will use a new number.

description.description: One or two sentences about the collection.

text.description: A string with at least one non-whitespace character. Readers trim it.

url.description: Where the songbook (a .sbk file or a songbook.json) is: a relative reference, resolved against the collection document's URL, or an absolute http(s) URL. Other schemes are rejected. The resolved URL is the book's identity: links and favourites use it, so keep it when replacing the file.

name.description: Display name of the songbook, normally the name in its own manifest.

description.description: One or two sentences about the songbook.

songs.description: How many pieces the songbook holds.

size.description: Size of the songbook file in bytes.

updated.description: When the songbook file last changed.
